instruction: Swap the two blocks using the empty mat, pressing the button after each move.

arguments.note: I will move the left block to the empty middle mat, then move the right block left, and finally move the middle block right, pressing after each placement.

arguments.hindsight: The second block slipped during transfer and required recovery. A more secure grasp and greater clearance from the idle arm would have preserved the intended three-move sequence.
